About Intelligo

Intelligo is a tech-enabled due diligence platform for global open source research into individuals and companies. We’re a well-funded Series B company with proven product-market fit over a decade . Intelligo is based  in Israel with employees in multiple countries and a hub in New York.

Our mission is to empower trust. Some of the most sophisticated institutional investors, investment banks, law firms, and corporations use our AI-powered platform to manage the risk of transacting with new people and businesses. Our platform leverages technology to conduct research quickly, produce in-depth reports, and continuously monitor subjects with speed and accuracy. Combined with an intuitive interface, Intelligo makes ordering and taking delivery of reports easy and hassle free.
